privacyPolicy.p2: Data is collected via forms, cookies, and third-party tools like analytics. We will never sell your data to third parties.
privacyPolicy.p3: By using our services, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. You have the right to access, modify, or delete your data by contacting us.
privacyPolicy.p4: This policy may be updated periodically. Please review it regularly.

cookiesPolicy.title: Cookies Policy
cookiesPolicy.p1: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze traffic, and provide personalized content.
cookiesPolicy.p2: By using this website, you consent to the use of cookies. You may choose to disable cookies through your browser settings, but some features of the site may not function properly.
cookiesPolicy.p3: Cookies are used for login sessions, preferences, and analytics. Third-party services may also set cookies on your device.
cookiesPolicy.p4: You can manage or revoke cookie consent at any time by clearing cookies in your browser.
